remarks: Enjoy Ellicottville from a location that puts four-season fun right outside your door. This beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-full-bath Glen Burn Trail townhome offers 1,712 square feet of comfortable, turnkey living just a short walk from the shops, restaurants and nightlife of the Village and minutes from Holiday Valley and HoliMont. Built in 2020, the home features an open and inviting main living space centered around a gas fireplace, an eat-in kitchen with quartz countertops, dining space and plenty of room to gather after a day on the slopes or trails. Central air provides summer comfort, while the attached one-car garage offers convenient parking and additional storage for skis, bikes and all the gear that comes with the Ellicottville lifestyle. Three bedrooms and a den provide plenty of sleeping space, making this an ideal year-round residence, weekend getaway or investment opportunity. Glen Burn Trail offers the low-maintenance lifestyle buyers are looking for in one of Ellicottville's most convenient locations—close enough to walk into the Village while still providing a comfortable retreat when the day is done. Highlights include: New custom top-down/bottom-up blinds throughout, new dishwasher, oven microwave, washer and dryer, new family room furniture, new Custom stone-work. It's never been rented. Offered mostly furnished for an easy transition to your new Ellicottville home.
